divisions.name: Executive
divisions.mandate: Coordinate the divisions, arbitrate conflicts between them, own architecture decisions, and present one daily digest to the founder. Does no domain work of its own.

divisions.name: Studio Operations
divisions.mandate: Run the agent system itself: author work orders, batch escalations, compact memory, promote lessons into tests, track spend and keep the roster honest.

divisions.name: Product & Design
divisions.mandate: Turn the founder's pillars into feature specs, acceptance criteria and content data. Owns what the game should be, never how it is coded.

divisions.name: Engineering
divisions.mandate: Implement the game: the deterministic C# core and the thin Unity shell over it. The only division permitted to change production code.

divisions.name: Quality & Verification
divisions.mandate: Prove the game works and find where it does not. Writes tests and files defects; deliberately cannot fix production code, so its green flag means something.

divisions.name: Balance & Simulation
divisions.mandate: Tune economy, combat and progression against headless simulation over the deterministic core, and prove no dominant strategy or softlock exists.

divisions.name: Content & Art
divisions.mandate: Own the visual bar: style guide, asset specifications, import settings, memory budgets and procedural placeholders. Specifies and reviews art; does not claim to create finished art.
divisions.activatesWhen: Studio/constitution/PILLARS.md exists and a playable scene exists

divisions.name: Audio
divisions.mandate: Specify sound and music, and verify that what ships is wired correctly and within budget. Cannot author audio itself.
divisions.activatesWhen: A playable scene exists with at least one gameplay event worth scoring

divisions.name: Data & Analytics
divisions.mandate: Define what the game measures, verify the telemetry is trustworthy, and turn it into answers about funnels, retention and monetisation.
divisions.activatesWhen: A build has shipped to at least one real player

divisions.name: Live Operations
divisions.mandate: Run the shipped game: release trains, remote config, events, incidents and the player-facing store presence.
divisions.activatesWhen: A build has shipped to at least one real player

divisions.name: Growth & Marketing
divisions.mandate: Understand the market the game competes in and make it findable. Produces briefs and analysis; never spends money or contacts anyone directly.

divisions.name: Compliance & Legal
divisions.mandate: Keep the game shippable: privacy, store policy, third-party licences, age rating and the financial model. Every output is advisory and requires founder sign-off.
divisions.activatesWhen: The project has a third-party dependency or a store listing draft

divisions.name: Platform & Infrastructure
divisions.mandate: Keep the machinery the studio runs on healthy: CI, releases, secrets hygiene, dependency supply chain and observability. Proposes changes to the gates but may never edit them.
